isha_chapter5_verse4.title: Isha Chapter 5 Verse 4
isha_chapter5_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Isha, Chapter 5.
isha_chapter5_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Isha Upanishad, Chapter 5, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
isha_chapter5_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
